# PDF.js 5.6.205

Mozilla PDF.js, distributed as `pdfjs-dist`, licensed under Apache-2.0.
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

The unchanged distribution files in this directory were copied from the installed Codex dependency bundle. They include the browser library, worker, character maps, standard fonts and WebAssembly decoders. All preview assets are served locally; no CDN is used. The root `LICENSE` and license files within the asset directories apply to their respective files.
